description: This file contains functions and commands related to managing model fallback configurations in an OpenClaw project, including listing, adding, removing, and clearing fallback models.

methods.name: getFallbacks
methods.description: Retrieves fallback model values for a given configuration key.

methods.name: patchDefaultsFallbacks
methods.description: Updates the fallback configuration for a specific key within the overall config.

methods.name: listFallbacksCommand
methods.description: Lists current fallback models for a specified key, with options for JSON or plain text output.

methods.name: addFallbackCommand
methods.description: Adds a new fallback model to the configuration for a specified key.

methods.name: removeFallbackCommand
methods.description: Removes a fallback model from the configuration for a specified key.

methods.name: clearFallbacksCommand
methods.description: Clears all fallback models for a specified key.
